scenes.body: Consider a fictional school garden with a three year plan.
scenes.narration: Consider a fictional school garden with a three year plan. In 2020, students prepare soil and plant the first seeds. In 2021, they add beds for vegetables. In 2022, they build a compost area to reuse plant material.
